```python
from typing import List, Tuple

        current = max(current, end)

    return intervals

def intersect(intervals1, intervals2):
    res = []
    i = j = 0
    while i < len(intervals1) and j < len(intervals2):
        start = max(intervals1[i][0], intervals2[j][0])
        end = min(intervals1[i][1], intervals2[j][1])
        if start < end:
            res.append((start, end))
        if intervals1[i][1] < intervals2[j][1]:
            i += 1
        else:

    return res
```

```python
        (t("15:00"), t("15:30")),

        (t("10:00"), t("10:30")),
        (t("11:00"), t("13:00")),
        (t("15:30"), t("17:00")),
    ],
}

def available(start, end):
    for person_intervals in busy.values():
        for b_start, b_end in person_intervals:
            if start < b_end and end > b_start:
                return False
    return True

answer = None
for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
    end = start + DURATION
    if available(start, end):
        answer = [DAY, hhmm(start), hhmm(end)]
        break
```

```python
    h, m = map(int, hhmm.split(":"))
    return 60*h + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def is_free(schedule, day, person, start, end):
    for bstart, bend in schedule[day][person]:
        bs, be = to_min(bstart), to_min(bend)
        if start < be and end > bs:
            return False
    return True
```

```python
        "Monday": [
            (to_min("10:30"), to_min("11:00")),

    },
    "Alexis": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_min("09:30"), to_min("11:30")),
            (to_min("12:30"), to_min("13:00")),
            (to_min("14:00"), to_min("17:00")),
        ],

            (to_min("10:00"), to_min("10:30")),
            (to_min("14:00"), to_min("16:30")),
        ],
    },

            return False
    return True

for day in ("Monday", "Tuesday"):
    if day != "Tuesday":
        continue  # Margaret will not meet on Monday; the meeting is Tuesday before 14:30
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, DURATION):
        end = start + DURATION
        if end > PREF_END:
            continue
        if all(is_free(person, day, start, end) for person in schedules):
```

```python
def to_minutes(t):

busy = {

        ...

            bs = to_minutes(s)
            be = to_minutes(e)
            if start < be and bs < end:

    return True
```

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))

def to_hhmm(t):

busy = {

        ("Monday", "11:00", "11:30"),

    ],
    "Ralph": [
        ("Monday", "10:00", "13:30"),
        ("Monday", "14:00", "14:30"),
        ("Monday", "15:00", "17:00"),
        ("Tuesday", "09:00", "09:30"),
        ("Tuesday", "10:00", "10:30"),
        ("Tuesday", "11:00", "11:30"),

        ("Wednesday", "11:30", "12:00"),
        ("Wednesday", "13:00", "14:30"),
        ("Wednesday", "16:30", "17:00"),
    ],
}

def is_free(person, day, start, end):
    for d, s, e in busy[person]:
        if d == day:
            bs, be = to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)
            if start < be and bs < end:
                return False
    return True

def works(day, start):
    end = start + DURATION
    return all(is_free(p, day, start, end) for p in busy)

candidates = []
for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, DURATION):
        if works(day, start):
            candidates.append((day, start))

def sort_key(candidate):
    day, start = candidate
    # Robert prefers not to add a Monday meeting; use Monday only as fallback.
    return (0 if day != "Monday" else 1, DAYS.index(day), start)

candidates.sort(key=sort_key)
best_day, best_start = candidates[0]
print([best_day, to_hhmm(best_start), to_hhmm(best_start + DURATION)])

```python
import sys

def to_min(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_str(x):
    return f"{x // 60:02d}:{x % 60:02d}"

DURATION = 30
WORK_START = to_min("09:00")
WORK_END = to_min("17:00")

busy = {
    "Ryan": {
        "Monday": [("09:30", "10:00"), ("11:00", "12:00"), ("13:00", "13:30"), ("15:30", "16:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("11:30", "12:30"), ("15:30", "16:00")],
        "Wednesday": [("12:00", "13:00"), ("15:30", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
    },
    "Adam": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "10:30"), ("11:00", "13:30"), ("14:00", "16:00"), ("16:30", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "10:00"), ("10:30", "15:30"), ("16:00", "17:00")],
        "Wednesday": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("10:00", "11:00"), ("11:30", "14:30"), ("15:00", "15:30"), ("16:00", "16:30")],
    },
}

def overlaps(s1, e1, s2, e2):
    return s1 < e2 and s2 < e1

for day in ["Tuesday", "Monday", "Wednesday"]:

    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1):
        end = start + DURATION
        if day == "Monday" and start < to_min("14:30"):
            continue
        ok = True
        for person in busy:
            for s, e in busy[person].get(day, []):
                if overlaps(start, end, to_min(s), to_min(e)):
                    ok = False
                    break
            if not ok:
                break
        if ok:
            print([day, to_str(start), to_str(end)])
```

    DAY = "Monday"
    WORK_START = 9 * 60
    WORK_END = 17 * 60
    DURATION = 60

    # Constraint: these busy intervals are unavailable for each participant.
    busy = {
        "Danielle": [
            (9 * 60, 10 * 60),
            (10 * 60 + 30, 11 * 60),
            (14 * 60 + 30, 15 * 60),
            (15 * 60 + 30, 16 * 60),
            (16 * 60 + 30, 17 * 60),

        "Bruce": [
            (11 * 60, 11 * 60 + 30),
            (12 * 60 + 30, 13 * 60),
            (14 * 60, 14 * 60 + 30),
            (15 * 60 + 30, 16 * 60),

            (9 * 60, 9 * 60 + 30),
            (10 * 60, 11 * 60),
            (11 * 60 + 30, 13 * 60),
            (14 * 60 + 30, 15 * 60 + 30),
        ],
    }

    def is_free(person, start, end):
        # Meeting interval [start, end) and busy interval [bs, be) do not overlap
        # exactly when the meeting is entirely before or entirely after the busy interval.
        return all(end <= bs or start >= be for bs, be in busy[person])

# - Variables: start, end (minutes since midnight on Monday)
# - Domain: 9:00-17:00, with duration 30 minutes

WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 30

def minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(":"))
    return h * 60 + m

schedules = {
    "Patrick": [("13:30", "14:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],
    "Shirley": [("9:00", "9:30"), ("11:00", "11:30"), ("12:00", "12:30"), ("14:30", "15:00"), ("16:00", "17:00")],

    "David": [("9:00", "9:30"), ("10:00", "10:30"), ("11:00", "14:00"), ("14:30", "16:30")],
}

busy = {
    name: [(minutes(s), minutes(e)) for s, e in intervals]
    for name, intervals in schedules.items()
}

def is_free(start, end):
    for intervals in busy.values():
        for bs, be in intervals:
            if start < be and bs < end:
                return False
    return True

latest_start = WORK_END - DURATION
for start in range(WORK_START, latest_start + 1, DURATION):
    end = start + DURATION
    if is_free(start, end):
        start_str = f"{start // 60:02d}:{start % 60:02d}"
        end_str = f"{end // 60:02d}:{end % 60:02d}"
        print([DAY, start_str, end_str])
        break
```

def fmt(m):
    return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"

WORK_START = to_minutes("09:00")
WORK_END = to_minutes("17:00")
DURATION = 30

schedules = {
    "Amanda": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
            (to_minutes("12:30"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:00")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:00")),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("09:30")),
            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:30"), to_minutes("12:00")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("15:30"), to_minutes("16:00")),
            (to_minutes("16:30"), to_minutes("17:00")),
        ],
    },
    "Nathan": {
        "Monday": [
            (to_minutes("10:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("11:30")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
        ],
        "Tuesday": [
            (to_minutes("09:00"), to_minutes("10:30")),
            (to_minutes("11:00"), to_minutes("13:00")),
            (to_minutes("13:30"), to_minutes("14:00")),
            (to_minutes("14:30"), to_minutes("15:30")),
            (to_minutes("16:00"), to_minutes("16:30")),
        ],
    },
}

def available(participant, day, start, end):
    for busy_start, busy_end in schedules[participant][day]:
        if start < busy_end and end > busy_start:
            return False
    return True

def valid(day, start, end):
    if day not in ("Monday", "Tuesday"):

        return False
    return all(available(p, day, start, end) for p in schedules)

answer = None
for day in ("Monday", "Tuesday"):
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, 30):
        end = start + DURATION
        if valid(day, start, end):
            answer = [day, fmt(start), fmt(end)]
            break
    if answer:
        break

print(answer)

# Scheduling CSP:
# Variables: day, start_time (minutes after midnight).
# Domain: Monday-Thursday, 09:00-16:00, start_time in 30-minute increments.
# Constraints: a 60-minute meeting [start, start+60) must not overlap any busy interval.

WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60
STEP = 30
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]

def hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

BUSY = {
    "Natalie": {
        "Monday": [(9*60, 9*60+30), (10*60, 12*60), (12*60+30, 13*60), (14*60, 14*60+30), (15*60, 16*60+30)],
        "Tuesday": [(9*60, 9*60+30), (10*60, 10*60+30), (12*60+30, 14*60), (16*60, 17*60)],
        "Wednesday": [(11*60, 11*60+30), (16*60, 16*60+30)],
        "Thursday": [(10*60, 11*60), (11*60+30, 15*60), (15*60+30, 16*60), (16*60+30, 17*60)],
    },
    "William": {
        "Monday": [(9*60+30, 11*60), (11*60+30, 17*60)],
        "Tuesday": [(9*60, 13*60), (13*60+30, 16*60)],
        "Wednesday": [(9*60, 12*60+30), (13*60, 14*60+30), (15*60+30, 16*60), (16*60+30, 17*60)],
        "Thursday": [(9*60, 10*60+30), (11*60, 11*60+30), (12*60, 12*60+30), (13*60, 14*60), (15*60, 17*60)],
    },
}

for day in DAYS:
    for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, STEP):
        end = start + DURATION
        if all(
            not (start < busy_end and end > busy_start)
            for intervals in BUSY.values()
            for busy_start, busy_end in intervals[day]
        ):
            print([day, hhmm(start), hhmm(end)])
            raise SystemExit
```

```python
# Schedule a one-hour meeting for Natalie and William.
# Variables: day, start_minute; meeting interval = [start_minute, start_minute + 60).
# Constraints: within work hours and no overlap with any busy interval.

DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DURATION = 60
STEP = 30

def fmt(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

BUSY = {
    "Natalie": {
        "Monday": [
            (9 * 60, 9 * 60 + 30),
            (10 * 60, 12 * 60),
            (12 * 60 + 30, 13 * 60),
            (14 * 60, 14 * 60 + 30),
            (15 * 60, 16 * 60 + 30),
        ],
        ...
    },
    "William": ...
}

def overlaps(a_start, a_end, b_start, b_end):
    return a_start < b_end and a_end > b_start

def solve():
    for day in DAYS:
        for start in range(WORK_START, WORK_END - DURATION + 1, STEP):
            end = start + DURATION
            ok = True
            for intervals in BUSY.values():
                for b_start, b_end in intervals[day]:
                    if overlaps(start, end, b_start, b_end):
                        ok = False
                        break
                if not ok:
                    break
            if ok:
                return [day, fmt(start), fmt(end)]
    return None

print(solve())
```

#  - All participants are in the meeting for 30 minutes on Monday.

    return f"{t // 60:02d}:{t % 60:02d}"

    cur = day_start
    for start, end in sorted(busy):
        if start > day_end or end < day_start:
            continue
        start = max(start, day_start)
        end = min(end, day_end)
        if start > cur:
            intervals.append((cur, start))
        cur = max(cur, end)
        if cur >= day_end:
            break
    if cur < day_end:
        intervals.append((cur, day_end))
    return intervals

```
    day = "Monday"
    work_start = 9 * 60

    duration = 30

            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
```
